teachBack: A Web is proposed required proof roles for a transition. This example illustrates 300 app-asset units under a 1,000 cap, split 180/120; unused 700 is not debt. Proof-claim output is separate and does not mint the app asset. The real app mint policy, authenticated issuer path, proof production, validator enforcement and settlement are not established. The developer handoff is conceptual; Web/transaction commands are future proposals.
